description: Trace capture behaviour shared by pkg-r and pkg-py. The source is tests/shared/traces.json; the copy under pkg-r/tests/testthat/fixtures/shared/ is generated by scripts/sync-shared.sh. Edit the source and re-run that script.

content_capture.description: What content_capture_enabled() makes of the capture variable once trajectory logging has found tracing active. An unset or empty variable is turned on, since without it chat spans omit the messages. Any other value is a deliberate choice and is left as it was: "true" and "1" in any case mean on, everything else means off. `value` null means the variable is unset.

cases.name: an unset variable is turned on
an empty variable is treated as unset
any other value is an opt-out
